استنشقوا (form X)
# اِسْتَنْشَقُوا (istanšaqū) /is.tan.ʃa.quː/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِسْتَنْشَقَ (istanšaqa)
# اُسْتُنْشِقُوا (ustunšiqū) /us.tun.ʃi.quː/: third-person masculine plural past passive of اِسْتَنْشَقَ (istanšaqa)
# اِسْتَنْشِقُوا (istanšiqū) /is.tan.ʃi.quː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِسْتَنْشَقَ (istanšaqa)
